serverVerification.method: Read-only SSH inspection of current links, running process directories and every release-manifest file

synchronization.source: Verified server manifest, matching local files and archived release bytes; divergent files downloaded from the verified server release
synchronization.gitNormalization: Standard Git clean filters applied, including the configured line-ending normalization
synchronization.buildArtifacts: Verified against release hashes; app/dist remains excluded from Git
synchronization.localChanges: Post-release documentation moves, mock bindings, validation-tool changes and notes are preserved as uncommitted working-tree changes
